eligibility_tiers.line: If a public or private high school student has a 2.00 high school GPA, no admissions testing or ACT/SAT is required to be admitted to Columbus Technical College. The 2.00 cumulative high school GPA is the qualifying test score for these students.

If a student is a home study student or a public/private school student who does not have a 2.00 high school GPA, they will need a qualifying score on a standardized test such as the PSAT, ACT or SAT.
